title: Program: {name}

archiveModal.title: Archive this program?
archiveModal.description: It will be removed from your active programs list, but clients who are already assigned keep using it. You can publish it again at any time.

republishModal.title: Publish this program again?
republishModal.description: It becomes active again and reappears in your active programs list, ready to assign to new clients.

publishUpdateModal.title: Publish a new version?
publishUpdateModal.description: This freezes your current changes as a new version of the program. Clients who are already assigned keep their current version and are not affected — only newly assigned clients get this version. After publishing, you can sync existing clients to the latest version.

syncModal.title: Sync clients to the latest version?
syncModal.description: {count, plural, one {# client is} other {# clients are}} on an older version and will be moved to the latest published version of this program. This updates the plan they see.

revertModal.title: Revert all changes?
revertModal.description: This discards every change made since this program was last published and restores it to that version. Analytics already collected on the current draft's changes stay in your clients' personal history, but this action itself can't be undone.

versionsModal.title: Program versions
versionsModal.description: Each published update creates a new version. Below is how many clients are on each one.
versionsModal.userCount: {count, plural, =0 {No clients} one {# client} other {# clients}}
